This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed under section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to applicant Shubham, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.18/2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 9, 10, 11 of Child Marriage Restraint Act and Sections 363, 366, 376 (3),
109, 506 of IPC and Sections 5/6, 16/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 registered at Police Station Mehgaon, District Bhind (Madhya Pradesh).

sentences.text: The present applicant is apprehending his arrest in the aforesaid case where the applicant is said to have assisted the main accused Akash in abduction and rape of the prosecutrix who is a minor.
Learned counsel for the respondent No.1/State while opposing the application for grant of anticipatory bail has read out from the 164 statement.

Before referring to the same, it is necessary to mention here that the F.I.R. was registered on 01.02.2023 and the 164 statement of the prosecutrix Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132834356/
1 recorded a month later on 01.03.2023.

entities.text: prosecutrix Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In her 164 statement, she says that she was forcibly married to one Sachin by her parents and at the time of marriage, she was 14 years and that this fact was known to her husband and her in-laws.
She further states that her husband Sachin never made any kind of physical contact against her will.

Thereafter, she states that she had gone to attend the marriage in her relationship and she wanted to return home to her in-laws place when the co- accused Arti alias Shivani, is stated to have told the prosecutrix that she is also headed in the same direction and that the prosecutrix could accompany her in the car.
The vehicle was being driven by the co-accused Akash and the applicant Shubham was sitting in the vehicle.

Midway, the co-accused Shivani is stated to have informed the prosecutrix that there was a call from her home and that she was returning and that she would not accompany them in the vehicle any longer and that the prosecutrix could go ahead to her destination alongwith Akash and the present applicant Shubham.

The prosecutrix says that she resisted the proposal however, the applicant herein is stated to have in collaboration with the main accused and forcibly made her board the train alongwith Akash who is stated to have taken her to Farooq Nagar in Haryana and kept her their in a room and forcibly committed rape with her.
She further says that during the stay together the main accused Akash had also taken photographs of himself alongwith prosecutrix and threatened to make them viral.
Thereafter she says that a month later, she was recovered by the police who had reached there alongwith her parents.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that there is a further twist in this case.

A Habeas Corpus petition was filed before this Court which is W.P.No.20184 of 2022 by the mother of the prosecutrix for the recovery of the prosecutrix allegedly from the forcible confinement of the main accused Akash.

On 22.09.2022 during the course of proceedings, the prosecutrix herself appeared before the Division Bench of this Court alongwith the main accused Akash who was respondent No.6 in the Habeas Corpus petition and informed the Court that she had gone with the main accused Akash on her own volition as she did not want to go with the respondent No.4 in the writ petition with whom her parents had forcibly got her married to.

The learned Division Bench by order dated 22.09.2022 further recorded that in inquiry it was found that in the Birth Certificate and the High School Certificate, the date of birth of the prosecutrix was revealed as 21.5.2007 according to which she was found to be 15 years of age and thus a minor.

The learned Division Bench thereafter recorded its angst as follows :-
"
It is indeed shocking that the parents of........... married her to respondent No.4 while she was minor.
It is an illegal act for which they are also liable for action.

Nevertheless, as Ms.... is not inclined to go with her parents, we deem it proper to keep her in Nari Niketan One Stop Center at Bhind as in the obtaining facts and circumstances she cannot be permitted to live with respondent No.6 Akash, who is present in Court, for the reasons firstly she is minor and secondly there is no relationship with Akash in law."

After this order was passed by the learned Division Bench, on 01.02.2023 the present F.I.R was registered against the applicant and the main accused Akash inter alia for the commission of rape of the prosecutrix.
The statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under 164 on 01.03.2023 in which she has given a totally different versions and has made allegation against the applicant herein.

sentences.text: However, giving due regard to the fact that the prosecutrix herself had appeared before the learned Division Bench of this Court alongwith the main accused Akash and wherein she has stated that she had gone with the main accused on her own volition as she was forcibly married of to the person whom she had referred to as her husband, cannot be ignored as the said statement was made before the two judges of this Court which was recorded in the order dated 22.09.2022.

Thus, on a prima facie appreciation of material on record, this Court comes to the conclusion that apparently the case is one of consent though the prosecutrix is a minor and the role of the applicant herein even if deemed to be true and correct, is peripheral and not associated with the main offence of the rape.
Under the circumstances, the application is allowed.

It is directed that if the applicant Shubham herein is arrested by the Arresting Officer, he shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer.
C.C. as per rules.
(ATUL SREEDHARAN) JUDGE AK/-

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The vehicle was being driven by the co-accused Akash and the applicant Shubham was sitting in the vehicle.
A Habeas Corpus petition was filed before this Court which is W.P.No.20184 of 2022 by the mother of the prosecutrix for the recovery of the prosecutrix allegedly from the forcible confinement of the main accused Akash.

The statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under 164 on 01.03.2023 in which she has given a totally different versions and has made allegation against the applicant herein.
